description: Held-out quality-per-byte gain from allocating a fixed byte budget by measured per-tensor damage, vs uniform Q4_1 at identical size.
metric: ratio = KL(uniform_q4_1) / KL(allocated); >1 means allocation is closer to f32.
per_role_sensitivity_note: See data/Qwen2-0.5B/sensitivity.json for the -0.031 Spearman of reconstruction error vs real logit damage.
